description_en: Queries the impact of editing an AI model source
name: GetAiModelSourceEditImpact

parameters.help_en: The ID of the model source. Use the modelSourceId returned by CreateAiModelSource
parameters.help_zh: 模型源 ID，使用 CreateAiModelSource 返回的 modelSourceId
parameters.name: model_source_id

code.description_en: The response status code. Ok is returned upon success, and a specific business error code is returned upon failure
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned by the model source operation
data.description_zh: 模型源操作返回的业务结果

cleanup.description_en: The items to be cleaned up returned by the impact query, including model sources, models within the source, licenses, and billing projections
cleanup.description_zh: 影响查询返回的待清理项目，包含模型源、源内模型、授权许可和计价投影

items.description_en: The identifier of an item to be cleaned up
items.description_zh: 一个待清理项目的标识

references.description_en: The actual references to the model source in the current saved and published configurations
references.description_zh: 当前保存配置和已发布配置中对模型源的实际引用

apiId.description_en: The ID of the API that references the model source
apiId.description_zh: 引用该模型源的 API ID

logicalModelId.description_en: The ID of the logical model. Use the vm- identifier returned by the API operation
logicalModelId.description_zh: 逻辑模型 ID，使用接口返回的 vm- 标识

modelCardId.description_en: The model identifier. The source model card ID is used for regular models, and the vm- identifier is used for logical model entries
modelCardId.description_zh: 模型标识；普通模型使用源模型卡 ID，逻辑模型入口使用 vm- 标识

objectId.description_en: The identifier of the object that references the model source
objectId.description_zh: 引用该模型源的对象标识

objectType.description_en: The new LogicalModel reference location, which is optional for legacy API references
objectType.description_zh: 新增LogicalModel引用定位，旧API引用可省略
objectType.title_en: 新增LogicalModel引用定位，旧API引用可省略
objectType.title_zh: 新增LogicalModel引用定位，旧API引用可省略

role.description_en: The purpose of the model source in the reference configuration, such as selected model, fallback model, or service binding
role.description_zh: 模型源在引用配置中的用途，包括选定模型、备用模型或服务绑定

routeId.description_en: The ID of the route where the published reference resides
routeId.description_zh: 已发布引用所在的路由 ID

serviceId.description_en: The ID of the actual AI service to which the model source is bound
serviceId.description_zh: 模型源绑定的实际 AI 服务 ID

state.description_en: Indicates whether the model source reference is from the saved configuration (Draft) or the published configuration (Published)
state.description_zh: 模型源引用来自保存配置（Draft）还是已发布配置（Published）

sourceVersion.description_en: The model source version read when the impact is queried
sourceVersion.description_zh: 查询影响时读取的模型源版本

message.description_en: The response message that describes the result of the request
message.description_zh: 响应消息，用于说明请求处理结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID generated by the system to trace the call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用
